eden_source: https://git.eden-emu.dev/Takoroka/eden-nx2 (branch eden-nx2), branched from Eden master at 26a03d2473, with Switch 2 support
boost_usage: Headers and matching Boost.Context fcontext wrappers plus x86-64 SysV assembly compiled for each target; no host Boost binaries linked into the PS5 build.
compiler_rt_usage: emutls.c and its four int_*.h headers. CMake changes only EMUTLS_SKIP_DESTRUCTOR_ROUNDS from 0 to 1 for libc++abi's pthread-key fallback; host uses the same helper with -femulated-tls. Cached input hashes are in CANDIDATE.json. cxa_thread_atexit.reference.cpp is inspected only.
